summary: Complete testing of Support Ticket System (Ajuda e Suporte) for 4Luis platform. All backend API endpoints and frontend UI flows working correctly. System supports ticket creation with auto-ID (SUP-2026-XXXXX), status management, priority auto-assignment, admin actions, and internal notes.
passed_tests: Backend: POST /api/support/tickets - creates ticket with SUP-2026-XXXXX format ID, status 'Aberto', auto-priority based on type
Backend: Priority auto-rules: Pagamento=Alta, Reclamacao=Alta, Problema tecnico=Media, Sugestao=Baixa
Backend: GET /api/support/tickets - lists user tickets (excludes internal_notes)
Backend: GET /api/support/tickets/{ticket_id} - returns ticket detail without internal_notes for user
Backend: POST /api/support/tickets/{ticket_id}/reply - user reply changes status from 'A aguardar resposta' to 'Em analise'
Backend: GET /api/admin/support/tickets - lists all tickets with filters (status, ticket_type, priority, search)
Backend: GET /api/admin/support/tickets/{ticket_id} - includes internal_notes for admin
Backend: POST /api/admin/support/tickets/{ticket_id}/reply - admin reply with sender='admin', sender_name='Equipa 4Luis'
Backend: PUT /api/admin/support/tickets/{ticket_id}/status - change status (Aberto, Em analise, A aguardar resposta, Resolvido, Fechado)
Backend: PUT /api/admin/support/tickets/{ticket_id}/priority - change priority (Baixa, Media, Alta, Urgente)
Backend: POST /api/admin/support/tickets/{ticket_id}/note - add internal note with note_id
Backend: POST /api/support/upload - file upload (returns 401 without auth)
Backend: Auth enforcement - user endpoints require auth (401), admin endpoints require admin role (403)
Frontend: Dashboard shows 'Ajuda e Suporte' section with ticket list
Frontend: 'Abrir novo pedido' button navigates to /support/new
Frontend: /support/new form has auto-filled nome/email (disabled), tipo dropdown, assunto, descricao, anexo upload
Frontend: Form validation working - required fields enforced
Frontend: Ticket submission shows success screen with SUP-2026-XXXXX reference
Frontend: /support/{ticketId} shows ticket header (ID, subject, status badge), conversation, reply input
Frontend: Admin tab 'Suporte' renders AdminSupportSection with table (ID, utilizador, tipo, assunto, estado, prioridade, data)
Frontend: Admin filters working (status, tipo, prioridade) and search input
Frontend: Admin ticket detail shows conversation, reply input, sidebar with estado/prioridade dropdowns
Frontend: Admin 'Marcar como resolvido' and 'Fechar pedido' quick action buttons present
Frontend: Admin internal notes section with add note functionality working
critical_code_review_comments: Ticket ID generation using year and sequential count is good for human readability
Priority auto-rules correctly implemented based on ticket type
Internal notes properly hidden from user API responses via projection
Status transition logic for user replies correctly implemented
Email notifications sent for ticket creation, admin reply, status changes
seed_data_creation: Created test tickets during testing: SUP-2026-00002 through SUP-2026-00006
context_for_next_testing_agent: Support ticket system fully tested. Key endpoints: POST/GET /api/support/tickets, POST /api/support/tickets/{id}/reply, GET/POST/PUT /api/admin/support/tickets. Ticket types: Problema tecnico, Pagamento, Conta e acesso, Convites e referrals, Viagens e sonhos, Reclamacao, Sugestao, Outro. Statuses: Aberto, Em analise, A aguardar resposta, Resolvido, Fechado. Priorities: Baixa, Media, Alta, Urgente. Frontend routes: /support/new (create), /support/:ticketId (detail). Admin tab 'Suporte' in /admin page. Key data-testids: support-dashboard, new-ticket-btn, new-ticket-form, select-type, input-subject, input-description, submit-ticket-btn, ticket-header, conversation, reply-section, admin-support-section, support-search, filter-status, filter-type, filter-priority, support-tickets-table, admin-ticket-detail, admin-reply-input, admin-status-select, admin-priority-select, mark-resolved-btn, close-ticket-btn, internal-note-input, add-note-btn.
